_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Shaped Charge Jet Impact Test Data
summary: Specifies the format and content preparation instructions for the test and inspection conditions and results of a shaped charge jet impact test used to evaluate a test item's response to jet impact.
description_purpose: This data comprises the test and inspection conditions and results of the shaped charge jet impact test. It is used to evaluate the response of the test item impacted by the jet of a shaped charge.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for data generated by the shaped charge jet impact test of MIL-STD-2105.

The following DID is used in conjunction with this DID and applies only if listed on the DD Form 1423 incorporated into the contract:
DI-SAFT-81126 Photographic Requirements
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The shaped charge jet impact test data shall be formatted in accordance with figures 1, 2 and 3.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The shaped charge jet impact test data shall include the information of figures 1, 2 and 3 and the following:

children.title: Location and identification of the post-test remains
children.content: Location and identification of the post-test remains depicted onto figure 2.

children.title: Description, location (linear and angular distance from original test position), dimensions and weight
children.content: Description, location (linear and angular distance from original test position), dimensions and weight of the post-test remains tabulated onto figure 3.

figures.caption: Shaped charge jet impact test data sheet.
